# Test fixtures

`plans.jsonl`: seven real plans in the unified format (one per room count, 4 to 10), taken
from the training split built by `make data`.

They derive from the Swiss Dwellings dataset v3.0.0 by Archilyse AG
(https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.7788422), licensed under CC BY 4.0. Changes: apartments were
rotated, rectified, snapped to a 10 cm grid and converted to the project format.
